displayName.label: Display name
displayName.invalid: Enter a name of 1 to 64 characters.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.helper: Share your Account ID so friends can reach you.

qr.title: My QR code
qr.helper: Friends scan this to start a chat with you.

errors.busy: The server is busy. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

recoveryKey.title: Your recovery key is a spare key
recoveryKey.body: Lost all your devices? Your recovery key and Account ID bring your account back. Old chats don't come back. Keep the key secret and safe. Never show it to anyone.
recoveryKey.note: You can view your key again on this device after you confirm it's you. If you create a new one, the old one stops working.
recoveryKey.confirmBody: The old one stops working. You then see the new kit; save it.
recoveryKey.unsynced_one: Your old key still works on {{count}} server until it syncs.
recoveryKey.unsynced_other: Your old key still works on {{count}} servers until they sync.

reveal.title: Recovery key
reveal.reason: Confirm it's you to view your gim recovery key
reveal.unlocking: Confirm it's you with Windows Hello or your Windows password.
reveal.canceled: We couldn't confirm it's you. Try again to view your recovery key.
reveal.unavailable: This device can't confirm it's you, so your recovery key can't be shown here.
reveal.notHeldTitle: This device doesn't have your recovery key
reveal.notHeldBody: It was linked with a QR code or set up before keys were kept on devices. Create a new recovery key: the old one stops working, and you can view the new one here later.
reveal.warning: Anyone with this key and your Account ID can take over your account. Never show it to anyone.

list.title: Linked devices
list.removeBody: It leaves all your chats and can't sign in any more. This can't be undone.

link.title: Link a new device
link.body: On the new device, choose “Link to a device you already use” and copy the code it shows.
link.invalidCode: This is not a valid link code.
link.compareBody: The new device shows a code too. Confirm only if both codes are the same; the new device then gets access to all your chats.
link.linked: The new device is linked. It joins your chats on its next sync.
link.rejected: The new device was not linked.
link.noQrFound: No QR code found in this image. Try another picture or paste the code.

errors.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
